inline_text:
In policies-guidelines/social-guidelines.md the Give Credit bullet reads:

  "Reposting individuals will be limited due the vast number of contributors."

The word "to" is missing. The correct text is:

  "Reposting individuals will be limited due to the vast number of contributors."
